title: Borrower Check-In Confirmations During Care (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
While a health-care absence is monitored on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, the absent primary borrower, still in care, may confirm a check-in in person on the handling date: the borrower confirms remaining in care and intending to return home. This entry governs the number that check-in carries; the monitoring it belongs to remains as the product's rules on health-care absences provide.

## Check-ins during monitoring

During monitoring a check-in is made every interval between contacts set for the plan, counted in calendar days from the absence start date, and annual notices are suspended; a check-in the borrower confirms in person while still in care is numbered under this rule, a contact confirmed by an accepted facility letter and the closing contact in which the borrower confirms having come home are numbered under their own rules, and every other check-in is numbered by the count of check-ins of the current absence plus one.

## Condition on the profile

> The borrower's own check-in is not numbered until the contact confirmed by the most recently received accepted facility letter stands on the profile as a recorded check-in.

Restated: so long as the contact that the most recently received accepted facility letter confirms does not appear on the profile as a recorded check-in, the borrower's own check-in receives no number.

## Who runs the tool

`confirm_absence_checkin_948ffc7a` belongs to the customer. The servicing agent unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves — the absent borrower — runs it to confirm the check-in in person. The entry is dated on the day it is run.

## Parameters

- `residency_profile_id` — reference number of the borrower's occupancy certification profile, as the servicing agent reads it out from the profile lookup; an identifier.
- `checkin_sequence` — the check-in number the confirmation is recorded under on the profile, as the servicing agent states it; an integer, 1-based, written without decimals.

## Effect and receipt

One check-in entry dated today is added to the profile's occupancy history, carrying the check-in number given, the profile's primary borrower and its loan program. Nothing else on the profile changes. The borrower hears a one-line confirmation of the form "Check-in <entry reference> confirmed for profile <profile reference>: number <check-in number>, dated <today's date YYYY-MM-DD>." The entry reference is the new history entry's reference number; its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the check-in entry now exists, and the occupancy history lookup shows it.
